sections.title: Pros
sections.narration: The upsides first: contains useful polyphenols. Adds plant-compound value beyond the core table. One of the clearest healthy-fat nuts. Walnuts have one of the strongest reputations and practical cases for elite fat quality in the nut category. Can be very satiating. Dense fats and texture can help fullness in practice.

closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, fibre, and protein, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin B12, low iron, and easy to overeat calories quickly. It is good for heart health, hormone health, and digestion because fibre supports the heart-health side, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and fibre supports digestion and steadier meals.
